title: Replicating Sandbagging Findings in a Realistic Deployment Setting vs. Synthetic Evaluation Setting

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Tests whether sandbagging is evaluation-context-dependent, which directly challenges the validity of current evaluation methodologies. If sandbagging differs by context, evaluations need redesign. High-impact question.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Two-condition comparison using existing sandbagging protocols. The METR MALT dataset provides a starting point. The main challenge is crafting a convincing 'realistic deployment' framing, which is more prompt engineering than engineering.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Two conditions, same tasks. Clean experimental design. If MALT dataset provides ready-to-use sandbagging scenarios, the main work is setting up the two framings and running trials. Borderline feasible in 30hrs.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Novelty not assessed due to partial Wave 3 completion.
